purpose: Execute the atomic resolve-edge-semantically operation within the MA-30 boundary: Root-only semantic edge resolver with a bounded predicate subset: required bbox and optional exact geometry type name. It does not implement adjacency, radius, or arbitrary predicates.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires resolve-edge-semantically and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Current root body whose edges are enumerated.

inputs.name: criteria
inputs.description: Must contain bbox_mm and may contain curve_type only.

inputs.name: bbox_tolerance_mm
inputs.description: Tolerance for the required axis-aligned edge bounding box.

preconditions: body is a current root DesignBody and passes assert_closed.
criteria contains bbox_mm and no unsupported keys.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The unique edge matching bbox_mm and optional curve_type.

postconditions: Edges are freshly enumerated and exactly one edge passes the supported predicates; one(...) returns it.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic resolve-edge-semantically operation within the MA-30 boundary: Root-only semantic edge resolver with a bounded predicate subset: required bbox and optional exact geometry type name. It does not implement adjacency, radius, or arbitrary predicates. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches raise through one(...).
Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: list(body.Edges) is obtained at call time; re-resolve after topology mutation.

failure_modes.condition: bbox is absent or an unsupported criteria key is supplied.
failure_modes.detection: bbox is absent or an unsupported criteria key is supplied.

failure_modes.condition: one(...) finds zero or multiple matches.
failure_modes.detection: one(...) finds zero or multiple matches.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

recovery.action: Supply bbox_mm and, optionally, curve_type from the supported subset.
Tighten bbox/type criteria or stop; no model mutation requires rollback.
